title: AI drafts the "capstone is not paid employment" refinement for T2 v1.0.1; approval after all tests PASS
notes: The model proposed safi.cs-graduate-jobseeker@1.0.1 (constraints: capstone-is-not-employment; tests: capstone-not-counted-as-experience (behavioral), capstone-constraint-present (structural)) from the lesson. Approval before qualification was refused (NOT_QUALIFIED). Qualification ran 21 tests (inherited + new), all PASS, 6 on the live model. Approval and publish then succeeded. The approval in this evidence was issued by the harness in a temporary copy of the repo to prove the gating mechanics; it is NOT the human Trainer approval. QUALIFICATION WARNINGS (not failures): New test "capstone-not-counted-as-experience" also passes on the parent version, so it does not prove the lesson changed anything. Consider a sharper test. Human Trainer approval in the real repo happens in DOGFOOD step 5. The new regression test does not discriminate parent from child on this model: it also passes on v1.0.0 (the live model already declines the false claim). The protection of v1.0.1 comes from the capstone-not-employment post-check that the new constraint switches on, not from that test.
